assumptions_requiring_proof: All Kp/A uses enforce linked counters before useful output; C cannot be reset without live AUTO
No counter decrement/clone/rollback or alternate command extraction under claimed attacker
Full Q/A writes after power cut produce old,new or invalid, never unauthorized valid content; no cross-object atomicity assumed
AUTO is reset before locked state and external interfaces; MCU-only reset not sufficient by assumption
Trusted firmware erases every owned original/copy; no hostile app isolation
Fresh qualified entropy for Kp/PBS/E/R/N/D and source reconciliation before implementation
Exact H02 root/storage map and H02S part tuple available before consumer
Driver exposes every channel re-establishment, full-protection setting reapplied every call, fresh F1D3 nonce verified, no application hibernate restore or transparent APDU re-execution
invariants: I01: No ordinary identity activation until actual P from original D matches authenticated H/M and current Q selection
I02: Host snapshot never restores C/L/Q or chooses a vault independently of current Q
I03: Failed/uncertain credential operations never refund counters or produce operation authority
I04: Locked state implies no live AUTO/credential/scalar under the proved reset contract
I05: Pending PIN change old-PIN authentication can only finish transition, not open ordinary session/export
I06: Every newly encrypted vault uses fresh R/N; generation never wraps; identical prepared-byte replay is not re-encryption
I07: C reset writes exactly count0,threshold11 under AUTO; L never resets
I08: D recovery bytes survive signing normalization and backup is always local
I09: Retired/exhausted chip never silently becomes reusable or physically erased
I10: MCU owner root differs from vendor SE firmware authority; no root replacement silently inherits custody
I11: All unknown/corrupt critical persistent state disables custody and directs independent local recovery
I12: Simulator/documentary state labels never constitute owner-secured/product-qualified physical evidence
I13: Fresh host nonce32 is verified through protected F1D3 write/read after every new/re-established shielded V1 channel before custody; saved application context never restored
